name: Ranger Witch Hunter
body:
Spellcasters can be dangerous if left unchecked. The witch hunter is trained to hunt down and deal with rogue spellcasters. For some societies, they can be a police force, protecting the populace from rampaging arcanists, while other witch hunters may have been wronged in their past and seek to end all spellcasters as a form of penance.

Favored Enemy (Spellcaster) (Ex)

At 1st level, the witch hunter is adept at hunting down and combating spellcasters. They gain a +2 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against creatures that can cast spells or use spell-like abilities. Likewise, they gain a +2 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against such creatures. Additionally, they can automatically determine if a creature they observe has the ability to cast spells or use spell-like abilities by succeeding on a Sense Motive check (DC 10 + the CR of the creature). Finally, any spellcaster within 5 feet of the witch hunter has the DC of any concentration check increased by 2.

At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter (10th, 15th, and 20th level), the bonus, and penalty to concentration checks, increases by 2.

This ability modifies and replaces the favored enemy ability.

Magical Defense (Ex)

At 1st level, the witch hunter is inured to the magics inflicted upon them.

They gain a bonus equal to 1/4 their class level (minimum +1) on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.

This ability replaces track and the wild empathy ability.

Harry Spellcasting (Ex)

At 3rd level, the witch hunter gains the Step Up feat, usable only when the target is moving 5 feet to cast a spell or use a spell-like ability. The ranger must otherwise follow the other rules of the feat.

This ability replaces the Endurance bonus feat gained at 3rd level.

Aurasight (Su)

At 8th level, the witch hunter can use the spell detect magic at will as a swift action.

They can continue to focus on the spell as a swift action each round.

This ability replaces swift tracker.

Cloak of Blankness (Ex)

At 12th level, the witch hunter, and the items on their person, are under a constant nondetection spell effect. The caster level of the effect is equal to the witch hunter’s class level. The witch hunter may raise or lower this protection as a free action.

This ability replaces camouflage.

Mental Bastion (Ex)

At 17th level, the witch hunter can empty their mind of thought and feeling, rendering them immune to mind-affecting effects. The witch hunter may raise or lower this ability as a free action.

This ability replaces hide in plain sight.
